from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperRecord(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_other_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperRecord]
